body_markdown:
**DALLAS** (November 23, 2026) — AECOM, the trusted global infrastructure leader, today announced that it has been selected to provide program management services for the Dallas Independent School District (DISD) 2026 Bond Program, the largest in Texas history. AECOM has previously provided program management services for DISD’s 2002, 2008, 2015 and 2020 Bond Programs.


The DISD 2026 Bond Program is a pivotal investment in public education, aimed at upgrading aging school facilities, bolstering student safety, and expanding classroom capacity. By modernizing infrastructure and enhancing learning environments, this initiative will create lasting benefits for students, educators and the community in Dallas.


“This award reflects the district’s confidence in AECOM’s proven ability to successfully deliver large, complex capital programs through an integrated approach that combines program management, planning, design, engineering, construction management and innovative program controls,” said Matt Crane, president and chief operating officer of AECOM’s U.S. & Latin America region. “It is an honor to help deliver the largest education bond in Texas history, creating modern learning environments that support the needs of Dallas students, teachers and staff for years to come.”


During this partnership, AECOM will provide leadership, oversight, and coordination for the delivery of eight replacement schools, twelve school additions and renovations, and renovations at thirty-two existing schools. Services will span the full project lifecycle, including planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout.


“We are proud to continue our longstanding partnership with Dallas ISD as the district invests in the future of its students and communities,” said Drew Jeter, chief executive of AECOM’s Program Management global business line. “This bond program is about more than improving facilities. It’s about creating safe, modern and inspiring places where students can learn, educators can thrive and communities can come together. Our role is to help Dallas ISD turn that investment into lasting benefits across the district through industry-leading program management and advisory services.”


DISD is the second largest public school district in Texas, serving 140,000 students at 228 campuses. Goals of the 2026 Bond Program include renovating aging schools, enhancing safety and security, advancing technology infrastructure and creating future-ready learning environments for students across Dallas.


**About AECOM**


AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management.
